data.long_meaning: The name Foster comes from the Old English word ‘fostor’, which means ‘cultivator’ or ‘supporter’. This name was given to those who took care of animals or children. It also symbolizes kindness, care, and nurturing. The name Foster carries the meaning “Cultivator, supporter” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Foster usually hope their child will grow to embody cultivator, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
